'''2001 Virginia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held at BC Comics, Centreville, Virginia on 26 May 2001. [[Dan Bojanowski]] won it. It is known from Wes Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-30-raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01d2396/ raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01], DeckTech (Wes "SeaRaptor" Brown, 30 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-30-raptors-return-va-states-26-may-01d2396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 May 2001
* '''Site:''' BC Comics, Centreville, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Bojanowski]]
